But the requirement: pass requires either showing difference not meaningful / within sampling noise, OR showing difference does not actually favour women (within treatment arm, men respond slightly higher). They have shown men respond slightly higher (2.87 pp lower for women). That satisfies (b). They also challenge premise. They didn't provide biological explanation. So they meet criteria.
